definitions.order: B1,C1,C2,B2,B3,C3,B-off,C-off, then P1,P2,P3,P-off. P is a separate later phase, not paired/interleaved evidence or a statistical causal comparison.
definitions.latency: Reported nearest-rank p50/p95/p99/max in milliseconds. Ack includes browser-shaped HTTP/auth/repository/projection work. Peer is repository-resolution to matching SVG plus two rAF, not exact SQL commit or physical display timing.
definitions.origins: Fixed initiating-route/stream labels; counts are retained measured-window method/query/pool completions. Nested wall times overlap and independent percentiles must not be added.
definitions.partialRequests: PARTIAL WINDOW: histograms group retained completions by numeric node/request ordinal, then omit those ordinals. Requests may start before or end after the window. Counts do not establish complete requests, per-request SQL totals or HTTP lifetimes. Stream work has no handshake ordinal.
definitions.sql: Direct wrapped Canvas SQL only; session/auth/feature-policy SQL outside wrapped Canvas methods is excluded. Presenter adds a second feature check outside this SQL profile. Direct query-count distributions join node plus numeric operation ID to retained completed command/get; counts do not describe all system SQL.
definitions.pool: Wait distributions are driver acquisition waits. Maxima are individual-pool samples at acquisition boundaries, not continuous maxima or total cluster connections.
definitions.calibration: Actual shaped health-fetch timings include browser/HTTP overhead and are not pure WAN RTT. Each actor p50 must be at least 80% of nominal CDP latency.
definitions.coverage: Measured writes/peer-paint epoch only; setup/warm-up/pre-window operations excluded. In-flight work is censored; orphan queries lack a retained completed operation. No dropped samples does not imply zero censoring.
definitions.comparison: Different measured-window durations and polling schedules limit comparisons of counts. No unqualified percentage load or latency improvement is inferred.

environment.resourceProvenance: artifact numeric environment plus run-owner-recorded VM/cache and quiet-host observations

oracleCorrection.predicate: Wait for BOTH authorized matching text plus two rAF AND a renewed stream request before measuring reconnect completion; retain final request-count assertion and real offline plus existing-stream interruption.
oracleCorrection.artifactTreatment: All twelve confirmation runs follow this correction. Earlier complete exploratory runs and the incomplete ordering-oracle run are excluded, not relabeled as confirmation evidence.

rejectedClientExperiment.archiveNormalization: Three optional blank-context space markers were omitted; applying the archive reproduces all four measured client source/test files byte-for-byte.

excludedArtifacts.label: candidate-pair-2
excludedArtifacts.detail: Offline recovery must open a renewed stream

limitations: Local ARM64 Mac, native headless desktop Chromium, PostgreSQL/cache in a shared 4-vCPU 8-GB VM; not target deployed topology.
Two API nodes share one coordinator process and monotonic clock; independently serving processes/hosts, proxy/TLS and WAN remain unmeasured.
Tiny synthetic 68-byte image and substituted in-memory image reads; real S3/scanner/full-media decoding and memory costs remain unmeasured.
Physical desktop/mobile/touch and physical presented-frame performance remain unmeasured; two rAF is only a paint opportunity.
Short closed-loop waves and one observing peer/guest do not establish sustained soak, all-to-all delivery or near-limit history/comments/receipts capacity.
Mac memory-pressure levels were occasional observations, not a continuous trace. No concurrent task build/suite ran during timing; the existing user stack was idle.
Profiling is bounded and omits non-Canvas SQL; retained completions can have censored in-flight work at stop. Profiling-disabled confirmations do not provide SQL/origin counts.
Every peer p95 exceeds 500 ms. The 20-editor workload is not an admission cap, and 500 objects/2 MiB/50 affected objects/64 KiB operations/5000 receipts remain unchanged.
